headline.text: L3 had *3 line stoppages* for mechanical faults—all cleared by mid-shift—while L2 ML3 demoulder remains down *1.3 hours* into the window with no ETA.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran clean through the night. S1 cleared a Matrix 10 conveyor jam in 65 minutes early morning. S4 fought 60-minute cook times all day—caustic cleaned both kettles and got caramel flowing again by 21:26. One quality flag on S1: chocolate coverage on piece bottoms needs operator attention.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML2 knocked out a PTL temperature fault and a bent door, both inside 2 hours. ML3 went down at 10:06 when the demoulder sliding plate fell off—maintenance is welding and replacing bearings as of 11:21 with no restart time posted. FFS cleared a pouch-folding jam in 2.3 hours overnight.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 stopped for temper at 06:13, back running at 06:48. Gondola jams from cross-conveyor product drops were fixed by ramp adjustment at 08:25. Truffle wire mesh and tunnel belt both repaired before 06:00. ML1 camera fault at 10:13 has no follow-up. Cavanna 2 sensor rejection issue raised at 10:57, maintenance on-site. MF Matrix Z-conveyor VFD fault cleared in 20 minutes.

notes.text: S4 identified root cause for slow cook times: operators pausing batches to avoid mixing kettles in reserve tank, causing caramel burn-on.
Tim and guests toured the plant starting 08:54; Chad Stone reports plant showed well and all shifts were tour-ready.

resolved.title: S4 kitchen cook times at 60 minutes vs. 45-50 normal
resolved.summary: Both kettles running 60-minute cook cycles all afternoon—steam traps checked OK, suspected burn-on from earlier downtime when caramel couldn't drain.
resolved.resolution: Both kettles caustic cleaned starting 14:46. Caramel flowing to Conbar tower by 21:26. 'We finally have caramel at the conbar tower' (William Beattie).

resolved.title: S1 Matrix 10 cross conveyor stopped
resolved.summary: Matrix 10 cross conveyor stopped at 01:52; maintenance troubleshooting on-site, bins accumulating.
resolved.resolution: Conveyor repaired and accumulation passed by 02:57. 'Maintenence got the coveyor running again. We accumulated bins which we passed before starting the line again' (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S1 Matrix 9 Videojet printer stopped
resolved.summary: Videojet on Matrix 9 stopped working at 09:48; Troy and maintenance swapping in replacement printer.
resolved.resolution: Troy swapped in a commissioned printer at 10:12. 'I just swapped it out and everything is working again' (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S1 enrober paused for temper adjustment
resolved.summary: Enrober paused at 18:40 for temper check and adjustment before resuming production.
resolved.resolution: Temper verified good and line resumed at 19:18. 'Line resumed' (S1 Enrober).

resolved.title: S3 x-ray machine jamming bottles
resolved.summary: Bottles jamming in x-ray at 20:04; line paused to pass accumulation and clear jam.
resolved.resolution: Jam cleared and line running again at 20:15. 'Line is running again' (William Beattie).

resolved.title: S4 separating table belt #16 crack concern
resolved.summary: Belt #16 showing a crack at 15:35; second-shift maintenance asked to check replacement availability.
resolved.resolution: William Lopez inspected belt at 16:14 and confirmed still functional, no FM risk or active cracking. 'Belt for separating table #16 is still functional no issues with FM or cracking.'

resolved.title: FFS pouches folding at bottom seal
resolved.summary: Pouches coming out with bottom folds at 18:53; line stopped, maintenance working to adjust forming and seal.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted seal and forming by 21:11. 'The pouch looks good' (Marlenis Fernandez at 21:11).

resolved.title: ML2 PTL temperature dropping and faulted
resolved.summary: PTL temperature fell and system faulted at 20:25; expansion tank pressure too low, melt head and pipeline stopped heating.
resolved.resolution: Alex Mendoza adjusted expansion tank pressure and brought system back to auto. 'Everything is back in auto and heating up' at 21:34.

resolved.title: ML2 cooler door bent and not closing
resolved.summary: Cooler door bent and would not close at 22:40; maintenance responded immediately to straighten.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance bent door back into position by 22:44. 'Door was bent back somewhat and line is running' (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML2 mold jam at demoulder
resolved.summary: Mold jammed at demoulder at 07:07, brief line stop to clear.
resolved.resolution: Jam cleared inside 3 minutes. 'The line is running back' at 07:10.

resolved.title: Truffle tunnel 3 belt fraying
resolved.summary: Tunnel 3 belt fraying on edge at 05:02; maintenance working to trim and seal to prevent FM risk.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance cut frayed edge, torched to seal, cleaned and QA verified by 05:58. 'Tunnel three is good to run' (Jordan Serna).

resolved.title: ML4 line stopped for temper check
resolved.summary: Depositor 1 temper flagged high; line paused at 06:13 for adjustment and capture test, back producing at 06:48.
resolved.resolution: Line resumed at 06:48 after temper adjustments and capture test verified good. 'Running at 6:48am' (Itzel Chavez); 'Running' (ML4 WDS Tablet 1).

resolved.title: MF Matrix Z-conveyor stopped
resolved.summary: Z-conveyor stopped moving at 07:36, product not rising to machine; maintenance on-site for VFD fault.
resolved.resolution: VFD fault cleared by 07:56. 'VFD fault needed to be cleared' (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle wire mesh issue
resolved.summary: Wire mesh on truffle line needed repair at 04:28; maintenance responded immediately.
resolved.resolution: Wire mesh repaired by 04:57. 'Wire mesh has been fixed' (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola entrance jams from cross-conveyor drops
resolved.summary: Six gondola jams reported between 07:17 and 08:01 caused by bites falling from TG3 cross conveyor onto gondola belt.
resolved.resolution: Stefan raised the TG3 ramp at 08:25 to seat product deeper into cross conveyor. 'It seems to be working' and 'Is still working better' confirmed at 08:48.

needs_attention.title: S4 tropical syrup cold, slowing tank fill
needs_attention.summary: Tapioca/tropical syrup arrived cold at 09:50, slowing fill rate to mixing tank and delaying batch cycles.
needs_attention.status: Cold tapioca reported at 09:50 and 09:51, impacting fill speed. Katya mentioned at 10:25 'We lost some time for cold tapioca' but caramel flowing again. Unclear if tapioca temp fully resolved.

needs_attention.title: S1 chocolate coverage on piece bottoms
needs_attention.summary: QA flagged at 10:44 that several pieces coming out with areas not covered by chocolate on the bottom; operator asked to improve enrober settings.
needs_attention.status: Operator asked to improve chocolate coverage on piece bottoms at 10:44. No follow-up posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: ML3 demoulder sliding plate fell off
needs_attention.summary: Demoulder sliding plate fell off at 10:06, line down; no replacement plates available, maintenance welding broken plate and replacing linear bearing.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance welding plate and replacing linear bearing as of 11:21. Hervin and Alan tested loose metal pieces against MD—all rejected. No ETA posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 camera fault
needs_attention.summary: Camera fault reported at 10:13, maintenance notified; no follow-up in chat on cause or resolution.
needs_attention.status: Camera fault reported at 10:13, maintenance notified. No update posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 sensor rejecting product
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna 2 sensors rejecting excessive chocolate at 10:57; maintenance on-site working sensor adjustments.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on Cavanna 2 sensor tuning as of 10:57. No resolution posted by end of window.
